title: Separate accounts not yet established — deadline still open
catches: A purely retrospective module missing a live, time-critical deadline.

expected.consequenceIfMissed: Section 401(a)(9) applies to the aggregate account; in practice the least favorable beneficiary's rules apply to all.

notes: Two distinct sequential dates: Sept 30 of the year after death identifies the designated beneficiaries (disclaimers and cash-outs through that date can remove a charity or estate and preserve DB status); Dec 31 of the year after death is the separate-accounting deadline. This is the one place the module should look FORWARD - a February packet that names an open deadline does something a year-end summary normally cannot.
